verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is a code-execution SDK, and nothing in the evidence shows a product-level way to version, review, or roll back automations. Directory snapshots that restore from R2, and the Git operations guide, are developer building blocks for filesystem state and repos. They are not a first-party automation versioning, review, or rollback capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
